'''Alantium''' was a [[Carbon/Legends|carbonate]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]<ref name="SWG" /> that was an important component in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] design. It was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Alabash]]<ref name="Freedom" /> and [[Alluuvia]].<ref name="Elrood" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] set up a [[Imperial mining complex|mining operation]] on Alabash that resulted in 600 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] being [[Mining/Legends|mined]] from the surface.<ref name="Freedom" />
